---
name: actions-debugging
description: Diagnose GitHub Actions failures and regressions using workflow runs, job steps, logs and reproducible fixes.
---

1. Identify the exact workflow, run, commit and job.
2. Inspect completed step results before editing code.
3. Reproduce the smallest failing command.
4. Fix the root cause rather than masking the symptom.
5. Re-run the focused workflow.
6. Verify generated artifacts and sync commits.
7. Never hide a missing dependency or unavailable source behind a green placeholder.
8. Record the final run identifiers and failure/fix chain.
